title: Polynomial-time producer step
statement: For every finite-state binary Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $C,e$, the producer-step function on Boolean words is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For every source machine and certificate parameters $C$ and $e$, the producer's one-step function on retained state words is polynomial-time computable, including retained copies, every per-tape search, and the clock increment.
